notes: Encoded ONLY from Goettl's own page. SHIPPED: page Style 1 only, year-only (the page's 3rd-5th digits are a Julian day, and the schema has no day field, so the day is noted here, not encoded). HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 2 (6-344026) — the page itself says the 1st-digit year reading is unconfirmed, and a single-digit year with no bound may not ship per policy.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = year (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open [0,2] -> '03' -> 2003. Page positions 3-5 = Julian day '150' for that year; no day field exists in the schema, so only the year ships. All-digit serial, so no counting ambiguity.
